articles.title: Treasury's Bessent sees crypto as America's next tool for keeping the U.S. dollar on top
articles.snippet: Speaking at Ripple's conference, the U.S. Treasury Secretary said the SEC and CFTC action could help fill the gap left by the Clarity Act's failure, while curbing crypto debanking.

articles.title: Robinhood's crypto revenue fell 55% from last year, but topped Street forecasts
articles.snippet: Crypto trading volume fell 38% from year-ago levels, but the firm's overall blockchain business gained traction.

articles.title: U.S. agency hits Utah with lawsuit to shield Kalshi's ability to offer betting there
articles.snippet: The U.S. Commodity Futures Trading Commission has pursued more than a dozen legal actions to protect what its chief sees as its sole power over prediction markets.

articles.title: Intel, Oracle, IBM join growing list of firms objecting to OKX–ICE tokenized stock plans
articles.snippet: The latest notice added four objections, bringing the total to 26 as the joint venture prepares to test the SEC’s new framework for blockchain-based stock trading.

articles.title: Brazilian companies turned to stablecoins on election day to dodge a currency crash
articles.snippet: USDT volume on crypto exchange Mercado Bitcoin jumped nearly 800% and bitcoin volume surged 865%. Binance’s USDT/BRL market tripled while the global BTC/USDT pair fell.
